title: Felix Side Cut Held
prompt:
Felix 找到侧面缝隙，按 Byleth 节奏停在接触线。 Youthful academy students, controlled nonlethal exercise, no UI.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded Action. Transition in: continues Scene09 tactical action geography. Transition out: cuts to the next tactical action beat. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: Felix slips toward the Black Eagles side gap with a wooden sword, sees the opening, but holds at the contact line rather than diving alone. His restraint is tense and unwilling. Byleth is a calm anchor in the background.
